project_info.theme: Hanoi International Marathon x Techcombank community celebration
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, vivid red, black, green, white

main_subject.detail: A wide dynamic marathon-event photo showing a crowd of runners in red shirts moving through a giant red finish gate branded 'THANH CONG VUOT TROI'. The header logos read 'HANOI INTERNATIONAL MARATHON' and 'TECHCOMBANK'. The large title says 'TRIEU KHOANH KHAC DANG NHO TU MOT CONG DONG PHI THUONG'. The road is lined with trees and morning sunlight, with motion blur on runners in the foreground and event posters mounted on both sides of the gate. Bottom-left text reads 'BUOC CHAY VI MOT VIET NAM VUOT TROI'.
main_subject.style: High-energy event-documentary hero image with brand-sponsorship overlay and cinematic sports atmosphere
